name: logiquote-demo-video

scripts.render: npm run manifest && remotion render Demo16x9 out/logiquote_demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --enforce-audio-track && tsx pipeline/finalize.ts out/logiquote_demo.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run manifest && remotion render Demo9x16 out/logiquote_demo_vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --enforce-audio-track && tsx pipeline/finalize.ts out/logiquote_demo_vertical.mp4
scripts.render:test: npm run manifest && remotion render Test12s out/logiquote_test12s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --enforce-audio-track && tsx pipeline/finalize.ts out/logiquote_test12s.mp4
scripts.test12: npm run record -- --storyboard storyboard.test.json && npm run stock -- --storyboard storyboard.test.json && npm run render:test
scripts.all: npm run record && npm run stock && npm run stills && npm run render && npm run render:vertical
scripts.demo:seed: docker compose -f demo-env/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U demo -d logiquote_demo -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < demo-env/seed.sql

description: Standalone demo-video pipeline for LogiQuote (not part of the app build/deploy)
